name: Media Bulk Zip Upload
description: Bulk upload media with zip files.
project_description:
Provides bulk upload functionality via ZIP files for configured media types.

 Features 
 
 Bulk upload Media entities using ZIP files 
 Configure enabled media types 
 Customise the bulk upload form with a special bulk_upload form mode 
 Event subscribers to alter the media entities before they are saved 
 
 Similar modules 
 
 https://www.drupal.org/project/media_library_bulk_upload - Bulk upload using the media library interface 
 https://www.drupal.org/project/media_bulk_upload - Bulk upload using DropzoneJS
